lines: Busujima Saeko
Well then, Fuuma. We're off. If fate brings us together again, we'll meet.
Me
Yes, Saeko-san. Thank you so much for everything. Take care over there!
Bathed in a faint, eerie glow that could be called divine, I exchanged farewell words with Saeko-san and the others.
This was the center of a collapsed city in some prefecture in the Kanto region.
We stood right in front of the "Gate to Another World," which had been the source of this zombie outbreak.
The Gate to Another World is a structure built with unknown technology that connects our world to a dimension different from our own.
The "Gate" before us now was connected to a world that had collapsed due to a massive outbreak of the walking dead.
It had summoned a large number of the dead into our world, causing the complete collapse of an entire city.
To stop such a catastrophic situation, a Taimanin unit consisting of me, Koukawa Asuka, and Izumo Tsuru had been dispatched.
While exploring the collapsed city, we encountered three girls who had been summoned to our world along with the zombies.
They were Busujima Saeko, Miyamoto Rei, and Takagi Saya.
They were tough female students who had survived in a dangerous world overflowing with the dead.
They had been stubbornly surviving in our world when they ran into us,
and we agreed to cooperate with each other for the purpose of "returning to their original world."
And now, we had reached the "Gate to Another World" that was the cause of the zombie outbreak,
and had just defeated the Gatekeeper, a demon from another dimension that had been guarding it.
Koukawa Asuka
Phew... Well, with that, this whole mess is finally settled.
Izumo Tsuru
Yes. I'm relieved that it ended safely, even in terms of Master's chastity.
Me
No, Tsuru? I tell you every time, but my chastity isn't in any danger, you know?
As we talked like that, we watched the three of them walk away toward the faintly glowing "Gate."
Once they returned to their world, destroying the "Gate" would complete our mission.
But just then.
Me
...Ah! I'm sorry! Wait a moment, all three of you!
I hurriedly called out to stop the three of them.
Saeko
...? What's wrong, Fuuma? Is it an emergency?
Rei
Did "them" show up again?
Saya
Ugh. I'm already at zero stamina from that fight earlier.
Me
No, that's not it. It's actually the opposite...
I explained the situation to the three of them as they turned back.
Me
I just received a communication on my terminal. "Them"──the horde of dead that had occupied this city has completely vanished.
It seems the Demon Realm Gatekeeper we just defeated was far more deeply connected to the "Gate" and the horde of dead than we had anticipated.
The moment the Gatekeeper fell, the dead stopped moving. In fact, they simply ceased to exist.
Furthermore, the reaction from the air mixed with the Brainflayer's secret treasure, the Tessaract, which had been flowing in from the "Gate," has also disappeared.
This means other Taimanin units, besides us, can now operate in this city.
Me
So, it seems we no longer need to rush the destruction of the "Gate to the Otherworld."
Rei
Wait? So we're just leaving this "Gate" as it is?
Me
No, we still intend to destroy it. Even though the Tessaract reaction has vanished, leaving it alone is too dangerous.
Me
However, they want to postpone the demolition for a few days to conduct an investigation in the meantime.
Saya
Huh. Well, do whatever you want, I guess. But what does that have to do with us?
Saya
You're not saying we can't go back to our world, are you?
Saya tilted her head in confusion.
Me
Of course, we won't hold you back unless you want to stay.
Me
But since we have a few days of leeway now, I'd like to properly thank you for your help.
Saeko
Thank us? For what? I appreciate the sentiment, but...
Saeko wore an expression that suggested she was not very keen on the idea.
Given that someone is waiting for her in her world, that was only natural. However...
Me
In a sense, you are the benefactors who saved this world from collapse. Please let us do whatever we can.
Me
For example, a delicious meal or a warm bath...
Three
The three of them's eyes lit up at my words.
And so, Saeko and the others decided to delay their return to their world for a few days.
They are girls, too.
After enduring a difficult survival lifestyle, it seems they could not resist the allure of good food and a bath.
They enjoyed a rare moment of comfort using the supplies brought in by the security forces,
And the next day...
Me
Come on in, Saeko. I have finished cleaning everything up, so it is safe.
Saeko
Ah. Thank you, Fuuma. You have arranged so much, and even indulged my whims like this.
Me
It is nothing. This is the least I can do.
I smiled and nodded at Saeko's words.
This was a high-end club located in a corner of the collapsed city.
Like the other places, it had been battered by the zombie attacks,
But I had hurriedly cleaned and tidied it up, restoring it to a presentable state.
It took a lot of effort, but it was all to fulfill Saeko's request.
Is there anything you would like to do while you are here?
When I asked her that, Saeko had said this.
Saeko
It might be difficult, but I would like to see a peaceful sea, one without "them."
To fulfill her wish, I had brought her to this high-end club.
Saeko
...No, wait a moment.
Saeko
Fuuma, I said I wanted to see the sea.
Me
Yes, you did. It sounds romantic and wonderful.
Saeko
U-um. But, this is... not the sea, is it?
Saeko
No, I trust you, and since you treated me to a feast last night, I do not want to doubt you.
Saeko
Even so, this place... looks like a bar where adult men and women drink alcohol, not the sea.
Saeko, looking bewildered, scanned the floor.
Indeed, this was a seedy establishment where wealthy old men would keep beautiful women at their side and laugh heartily.
Me
Well, I suppose you are right. It is not the sea, but a high-class club.
Saeko
Hmph...? Could it be that you are teasing me?
Saeko's eyes sharpened instantly.
Since Saeko still carries her sword, being looked at with that kind of gaze is quite frightening.
Me
Ah, no, no, that is not it! It is a high-class club, but at the same time, it is the sea!
Saeko
What do you mean?
Me
Well, to explain, this world is slightly in the future compared to your world, Saeko.
Me
Technology has advanced in many ways, and this club has a holographic facility that can reproduce resort locations.
Saeko
Hologram...?
Me
Well, it is not exactly a proper place. It seems it was not always used for wholesome purposes, but...
Me
Still, it is convenient in situations like this. Come, Saeko, this way!
Saeko
I headed toward the back of the floor, still accompanied by the slightly bewildered Saeko.
We arrived at the holographic facility.
It was a room designed to resemble a lounge at a luxury resort.
Outside the window, a night view, as if seen from a high-rise building, was projected.
Saeko
So this is the facility... Indeed, it has a rather mysterious atmosphere.
Me
Yes, it is daytime now, yet it is night outside the window. But, watch this, it will surprise you even more.
Saying that, I operated the panel installed inside the room.
Immediately, the night view outside the window switched to a different scene.
Saeko
Oh!? This is...!
Saeko let out a cry of surprise.
The scenery outside the window had transformed into a sun-drenched resort beach in an instant.
Saeko
Indeed... from here, it looks exactly like the real sea. Is this what is called virtual reality?
Saeko
You were right, Fuuma. It seems technology has advanced considerably in this world compared to ours.
Me
Yes. It is a slightly future era, and technology from the Demon Realm and other worlds has been integrated as well.
Compared to Saeko's world, the technology here is likely a completely different thing.
Me
Well, setting that aside, let's head out right away! You brought your change of clothes, didn't you, Saeko?
Saeko
Ah. Of course.
The holographic resort beach.
We, now in our swimsuits, immediately dove into the beautiful surf.
Saeko
Nngh! It's cold! And I can feel the sea breeze and the sunlight too!
Saeko
I'm surprised, Fuuma! Even if it is a holographic sea, I have no complaints about this!
Me
Haha. Thank you, Saeko.
Watching Saeko play in the surf, I smiled and nodded.
Saeko, in her swimsuit, was kneeling at the water's edge, showing me a smile.
It seems she has taken a liking to the sea at this virtual resort.
Me
Actually, it is difficult to go to a real sea.
Me
This city is inland, and given your circumstances, you cannot travel far.
Me
So, I thought of using this place.
Saeko
Ah. I am aware of those circumstances.
Saeko
That is why I was wondering if I had made an unreasonable request, but you fulfilled it.
Saeko
You are a reliable boy, Fuuma.
Me
No, it is nothing...!
Saeko looked at me with a gentle smile.
Saeko is cool, but she occasionally says things like this to boost a man's ego, which makes my heart race.
Me
Besides... Saeko, your figure is the best too...
I know it is rude, but I cannot help but let my gaze drift that way.
It is about Saeko in her swimsuit.
The swimsuit Saeko brought was a sexy bikini type, which is very stimulating for a healthy young man.
The chest area is widely exposed, and a soft, attractive mass is swaying right in front of my eyes.
Seeing such a perfect swimsuit up close, I cannot help but feel my heart pounding...
Saeko
Hehe, Fuuma-kun. With that face all red... where have you been looking all this time?
Me
Ah, I, I'm sorry...! My eyes just kept drifting over...
Me
It's just that you look so beautiful in that swimsuit, Saeko-san...
As I hurriedly apologized, Saeko smiled with amusement.
Saeko
Hehe, it's fine. It's a bit embarrassing, but there's no such thing as being offended by a compliment.
Saeko
Besides, I have a man I've set my heart on, and you probably have a girl who gets jealous of you too, right?
Me
Y-yes, that's true. Tsuru and the others are always a lot of trouble...
Saeko
Right? So we should probably both keep that in mind.
Me
Y-yes. Of course!
Still, thinking about it like that only makes it feel more forbidden and exciting.
Saeko
...Hm? Did you say something, Fuuma-kun?
Me
No, it's nothing! Anyway...
Me
Since we're at the beach, let's really make the most of today!
